svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: FRONTEND: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI, Motion. 3D & MOTION: Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, PBR materials, SVG & Canvas, Recharts. BACKEND & DATA: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Supabase, REST APIs. CMS & COMMERCE: WordPress, Block themes, PHP 8, Keystatic, Shopify, Elementor
